title: Vapouriz 50/50 Pink Lemonade 10ml
description: Pink Lemonade offers a lively burst of citrus fizz, blending zesty Lemon with sweet red berry notes for a flavour that’s sharp, bright, and refreshingly balanced. Each puff delivers a clean, sparkling sensation with a tangy-sweet finish that’s both playful and satisfying. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this versatile e-liquid provides a smooth draw with excellent flavour clarity and discreet vapour. It's ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod systems, vape pens, and starter kits. Expertly crafted by Vapouriz Labs in the UK, the Vapouriz 50/50 collection offers a wide selection of well-balanced flavours designed for reliable, all-day vaping. Whether you're using a beginner-friendly device or a more advanced setup, this adaptable e-liquid range offers something for every style. 50/50 e-liquid refers to the equal ratio of Vegetable Glycerine (VG) and Propylene Glycol (PG), allowing for an optimal balance between smooth vapour and strong flavour delivery. It’s perfect for use in starter vape kits, pod devices, and low-powered sub-ohm setups.
